produced.description: Minimal enterability classifier prototype that computes enterability classifications for (PSC, NAICS) sub-segments using cached USAspending recipient data
features: Classifies into HIGHLY ENTERABLE/SOMEWHAT ENTERABLE/MARGINAL/CLOSED per E220 thresholds
Computes seg_frac, frag, newcomer count from cached recipient data
Works without API calls - uses only pre-existing cached data
Results consistent with E221: NAICS 541511 and 541519 consistently HIGHLY ENTERABLE
artifacts_generated: CLAIM: minimal enterability classifier enables enterability assessment without 14+ hour API run

observed.key_finding_confirmed: NAICS 541511 (Custom Computer Programming) and 541519 (Other Computer Related Services) are consistently HIGHLY ENTERABLE across all 5 IT PSC codes (DA01, DA10, 7A21, 7030, D304)
observed.classification_counts: From cached data across 5 IT PSC codes: 5 HIGHLY ENTERABLE, 3 SOMEWHAT ENTERABLE, 5 MARGINAL, 6 CLOSED (19 total sub-segments with data)
observed.prototype_runtime: All classify/list commands complete in < 2 seconds without API calls
observed.cache_dependency: Relies on pre-existing cached data in tools/raw/ from E221/E209 experiments

build_decision: Created new tool script tools/minimal_enterability.py as a reversible exploratory prototype. This is evidence-gathering, not product validation, per AGENTS.md guidance Section 3 (prototype before committing to a product).
remains_unknown: Whether FY2022 data (multi-year window FY2022-2023) changes enterability classifications beyond FY2023-only results
Whether small program teams would actually use a simplified tool for enterability assessment
Whether enterability patterns hold across different fiscal years or are specific to FY2023
Whether the full 25-code API run would add meaningful new enterable sub-segments beyond the 5 IT codes

next_action.proposal: Extend the minimal prototype to support multi-year current window comparison (FY2022 + FY2023 vs. FY2018-2022 prior) using cached data
next_action.rationale: Directly follows from STATE-next-actions.md item (2) 'Validate multi-year current window (FY2022-2023) on priority codes'; runnable with cached data (no new API calls); advances the concrete problem of making enterability assessments accessible; validates the --multi-year framework already in tools/psc_naics_subsegment_analyzer.py
alternatives: Run the full E221 analyzer with --offline --max-psc 5 to confirm results on the 5 IT codes
Apply the sub-segment entrant advisor methodology to a new domain per D083 fresh observation
Build a batch/export feature for the minimal prototype to enable bulk assessment
